detections.description: Large, deep, irregular pothole with exposed aggregate and loose debris, indicative of severe pavement failure.
Smaller, shallower depression appearing to be a failed patch or developing pothole with some surface erosion.

detection.report_summary: The road surface exhibits significant structural degradation, primarily characterized by one large, deep pothole with exposed aggregate and loose debris, rated as high severity. A secondary, smaller and shallower defect, likely a failed patch or developing pothole, is also present with medium severity. These defects collectively indicate a critical need for immediate repair to ensure road safety and prevent further deterioration.
